# E0352: a remap passes values through to a target the lens cannot test them against

A value no arm of a remap maps passes through where the target accepts it. To
decide that, the compiler tests the source's values against the target field's
type, which must be self-contained: a type that refers to other fields cannot
be tested on its own. Map every value with an arm, or add a `[_]` arm.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
schema: {
	kind: "a" | "b" | "c"
}
```

`ship/1.0.thema`:

```cue
schema: {
	allowed: [...string]
	kind:    or(allowed)
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		allowed: ["a", "b"]
		kind: remap(v0_0.kind, {
			"c": "a"
		})
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0352]: remap of kind: 1.0's kind is not a self-contained type
  --> 1.0.thema:10:9
   |
10 |         kind: remap(v0_0.kind, {
   |               ^^^^^
   |
   = note: a value no arm maps passes through where the target accepts it, which cannot be tested against a type that refers to other fields
   = help: map every value with an arm, or add a [_] arm
```
